name: Orange Quantum Systems
description: Orange Quantum Systems develops automated quantum device testing and characterization equipment. Their solutions enable rapid and reliable testing of quantum processors, helping quantum computing companies accelerate development cycles and improve device quality.
accessModel: Hardware sales (quantum chip testing systems) + software licensing

products.description: Turnkey high-throughput equipment for testing quantum chips accommodating hundreds of qubits per chip

products.name: OrangeQS FLEX
products.description: Flexible quantum chip R&D system with configurable rack and control electronics

highlights: Test machines check quantum chips in days rather than weeks, enabling faster scaling

news.title: Orange Quantum Systems Raises €12 Million Seed Round
news.excerpt: Dutch startup Orange Quantum Systems raised €12 million in an oversubscribed seed round, the largest to date in the Netherlands' quantum computing sector. The funding will accelerate development of scalable quantum chip testing tools.
